requirements.summary: Create a minimal application shell with a single landing page that displays the app name “Aurise”.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the app shows a landing page with the title text “Aurise”.
No placeholder/lorem-ipsum branding text is visible on the page.

file_operations.description: Create the root React component that renders the single landing page (no extra routes/pages) and ensures the visible primary heading text is exactly “Aurise”.
Ensure the document title is set to “Aurise” and the base HTML remains minimal for a single-page landing experience.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive dark fantasy “aura” theme (high-contrast dark background, glowing accents, dramatic typography) across the landing page with English-only UI text.
acceptanceCriteria: The landing page uses a consistent dark + glowing-aura aesthetic (background, typography, and UI accents feel like one theme).
All visible UI text is in English.

file_operations.description: Add global theme tokens and base styles to support a dark, high-contrast aura aesthetic (typography, colors, and reusable glow utilities) applied consistently to the landing UI.
Extend Tailwind theme settings to support aura-themed design primitives (e.g., custom colors/shadows/animations) used by the landing page styling.

Implement the landing page layout and UI elements using the aura theme and English-only copy. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button/Card where available) to compose consistent UI elements without editing immutable ui component files. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the LandingPage into the app shell so the landing page is the only rendered page and the theme styling is applied consistently.

requirements.summary: Add a smooth animated aura visual effect to the landing page with graceful reduced-motion behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The aura effect animates continuously without blocking page interaction.
If the user prefers reduced motion, the animation is reduced or replaced with a static/low-motion variant.
The app remains usable and readable with the aura effect enabled.

file_operations.description: Create a non-blocking animated aura effect layer (e.g., pulsing glow/energy ring/particle haze) designed to sit behind content and keep text/buttons readable.
Add a small hook to detect the user’s reduced-motion preference and expose a boolean used to reduce/disable animations.
Add CSS animations and reduced-motion fallbacks (via prefers-reduced-motion) so the aura effect degrades to static/low-motion visuals on low-end devices or when reduced motion is enabled.
Wire the AuraEffect into the landing page behind the primary content and ensure pointer events/stacking keep the page fully interactive and readable.

requirements.summary: Include and render generated static image assets (background and emblem/logo) from frontend/public/assets/generated and incorporate them into the landing visuals.
acceptanceCriteria: The generated images exist in frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the frontend.
The landing page visually incorporates the generated background and emblem/logo assets.

file_operations.description: Add the generated static background image asset at the exact path frontend/public/assets/generated/aurise-aura-bg.dim_1920x1080.png.
Add the generated static emblem/logo image asset at the exact path frontend/public/assets/generated/aurise-emblem.dim_512x512.png.

Reference the static assets directly from the frontend (frontend/public/assets/generated/aurise-aura-bg.dim_1920x1080.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/aurise-emblem.dim_512x512.png) and incorporate them into the landing layout (background treatment + emblem near the “Aurise” title).
Add styling hooks for using the generated background and emblem cohesively with the aura theme (e.g., background placement/overlay, emblem glow framing) while keeping content readable.
